answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1725 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I want to ask you a question regarding salah. The imam of local mosque in Esah prayer said Allah u Akbar instead of Sami'Allahu li man hamedah n later did sajda saho. Does the salaah performed was correct? Question: I want to ask you a question regarding salah. The imam of local mosque in Esah prayer said Allah u Akbar instead of Sami'Allahu li man hamedah n later did sajda saho. Does the salaah performed was correct? Answer ID: 1725 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 488/488=L) Sajda sahw was not compulsory; the salah was complete without it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
